result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Contractor-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, with notice, cooperation, defence control, and settlement protections. The attorneys’ fee carve-out is reasonably necessary to avoid undermining the indemnity. No unnecessary Customer indemnity is added. Drafting is professional, though the fee-waiver exception could be slightly more precise by referring specifically to Contractor’s obligations under subsection (d), and the notice provision could clarify that delayed notice relieves Contractor only to the extent materially prejudiced.
